office_does: The assessor values every taxable property in Benton County each year for property taxes; taxing districts and voters set the levies.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Bill Spencer (Prefers Republican Party) is the only candidate and submitted no voters' guide statement.

candidates.summary: Incumbent Benton County Assessor, re-elected without opposition in 2022; the only candidate on the ballot.
